decisions.reason: Changing the underlying placeholder-field mechanism does not change the required behavior that placeholder text clears when the field is activated.

The robust replacement may preserve the grey visual cue or replace it with another cue; the client does not specify which interpretation applies, so the candidate's cue mechanism cannot be safely updated.
The decision to replace password-dependent legacy fields does not alter the independent requirement to preserve Title-field formatting.
The source decision concerns ordinary fill-in field controls, not transferring content from legacy templates or preserving pasted layout and styles.
Replacing the standard-text placeholder mechanism does not change the requirement that pasted content remain within column and page boundaries.
The supported Word for Windows environment and general operational-reliability constraint remain valid without modification.
The standard-text field mechanism is independent of manual line-break entry after legacy content is pasted.
The source decision does not address list-level transitions, Tab behavior, hierarchy structure, or list alignment.
The requested robust alternative for fill-in fields does not modify bullet dimensions, alignment, scaling, appearance, or level-four variant.
The placeholder-control change does not alter the PBU naming prefix, covered style categories, applicability condition, or naming language.
The source decision does not affect numbered-list alignment or multi-digit numbering behavior.
Selecting a more robust fill-in field mechanism does not change the specified style system or its required application across templates.
